title: Machine Learning Engineer
description_html:
About the role

Example Labs builds demand forecasts for regional retailers. You will join a team of six that takes models from notebook to production.

What you'll do

  • Build and ship machine learning models in Python
  • Turn prototypes into reliable data pipelines with Airflow
  • Set up experiment tracking and model monitoring with MLflow
  • Present results to product leads; stakeholder management matters here

What you bring

  • Three or more years with Python and SQL
  • Hands-on work with scikit-learn or PyTorch
  • Solid statistical modeling
  • Experience with Docker and CI/CD

Nice to have

  • Kubernetes or another container platform
  • AWS
  • A Master's degree in a quantitative field

Pay and benefits

  • Salary: $105,000–$125,000 CAD per year
  • Four weeks of vacation and a yearly learning budget
